1. **`server-adaptive-dm.h`** — Adaptive draft-model speculative decoding controller with EWMA-based profit tracking and probe fraction tuning. Upstream has speculative decoding but not this adaptive profit-controller heuristic layer.

2. **`server-loop-guard.cpp` / `server-loop-guard.h`** — Reasoning loop detection guard that monitors token tails for periodic repetition, n-gram dominance, and low-entropy patterns in reasoning (think) blocks. Prevents infinite reasoning loops. No upstream equivalent.

4. **`server-models.cpp` / `server-models.h`** — Multi-model router/manager with model lifecycle states (DOWNLOADING → DOWNLOADED → UNLOADED → LOADING → LOADED → SLEEPING). Manages child server processes per model, LRU unloading, preset-based model discovery, and on-demand model loading/unloading. This is the core of beellama's multi-model hosting architecture — upstream has no equivalent router layer.

5. **`server-stream.cpp` / `server-stream.h`** — Resumable HTTP stream session manager with ring-buffered SSE output keyed by `conversation_id`. Sessions survive client disconnects, support byte-offset reads, and have TTL-based GC. Upstream SSE is simple pass-through; this adds durability and resumability.

6. **`server-tools.cpp` / `server-tools.h`** — Dedicated tools endpoint management (`/tools` GET/POST). Appears to extend tool registration/discovery beyond what upstream handles inline in chat params.

7. **`bench/` directory** — Benchmarking infrastructure, new subdirectory with dedicated benchmark tools.
